_comment: THE CRAB'S OWN LOOK, TABLED (phase E6 - the crab as a document).
The seven shell colorways move out of sprites.js literals into the
bundled crab document. Order is LOAD-BEARING FOREVER: k.color in every
save indexes this list, so the bundled list keeps today's order and
new colorways only ever append. SUDSY's exclusive shell is the named
founder reference (founders.sudsy) resolved to an index at boot - the
pin is a NAME now, not 'whatever is last'. The house/boat/buggy
per-colorway DERIVATION stays engine (a colorway begets a house; the
palette is the data). Literals stay in sprites.js as the fallback;
adoption is in place before the art derivations run.
